notes.content:

notes.title: New demo version!
notes.content:
Play the new version of the King's Blade demo!

In the new version:
- Slightly changed levels.
- Improved the color scheme of the environment.
- All characters walk faster.
- Added new moves for Ervin and Lagard.
- Improved control setup for co-op.
- No longer need to select gamepad type in settings.
- Fixed bugs.
